about_short_description.short_description: Ribbon Health is a predictive analytics and data platform for the healthcare industry.

product.name: Ribbon Provider Data Platform
product.description: A platform that manages provider information for healthcare enterprises, including insurances accepted, cost, quality, and experience.

product.name: Ribbon Directory
product.description: A data asset on healthcare providers and facilities, offering detailed metrics like common procedures, affiliations, cost, quality, and more.

product.name: Partner Data Marketplace
product.description: A set of industry data partners integrated into the Ribbon platform for additional data attributes.

product.name: Data Integration
product.description: Automatically ingests and processes multiple provider data sources into one standardized database.

product.name: Accuracy Scoring
product.description: AI models assess provider data accuracy from 0% to 100%.

product.name: Master Data Management
product.description: A database to store, maintain, manipulate, and trace changes over time for compliance.
